BKK student monthly pass (bkk.hu prices and discounts).

items.authority: Tempus Public Foundation, for the Hungarian Government
items.description: Government scholarship for students nominated by a Sending Partner (partner country) under a bilateral agreement. Bachelor/master: tuition-free, HUF 43,700/month stipend (12 months/year), free dorm place or HUF 40,000/month for housing, Hungarian public health care plus supplementary insurance up to HUF 65,000/year. No EU member state appears in the 2026/27 Sending Partner list.

other: citizen of a Sending Partner country/territory listed in the call, and nominated by it
not eligible: Hungarian citizens (including dual citizens), refugees, stateless persons, long-term residents
must apply through the sending partner of your own citizenship
exchange (partial) study only from the partners listed for partial programmes

items.amount: Tuition-free + HUF 43,700/month + dorm or HUF 40,000/month (BA/MA, per the SH about page, EUR rates of 13 Oct 2025); PhD stipend HUF 140,000–180,000/month
items.how_to_apply: Online application on the Stipendium Hungaricum system and nomination by your country's Sending Partner.
items.deadline: 2026/27 call: 15 January 2026, 2 p.m. CET (closed). 2027/28 deadline not published on the pages read.
items.notes: Semmelweis lists Stipendium Hungaricum among its scholarships. The Semmelweis Pannonia In scholarship excludes SH holders.

items.description: State student loan for any use: HUF 15,000–150,000 per month (up to HUF 750,000 per semester). Variable interest, set per half-year period; the page shows a current rate of 8.18%. Repayment starts after studies and depends on income.

other: active student status at a higher-education institution
Hungarian citizen, recognised refugee, holder of long-term residence, or person with a right of free movement and residence in Hungary as defined by the regulation
last disbursement in the semester in which you turn 45

items.amount: HUF 15,000–150,000/month; max HUF 750,000/semester; interest 8.18% (rate shown Nov 2026)
items.how_to_apply: Online with an electronic signature via the Government Portal (Ügyfélkapu).

interpretations.hypothesis: EU/EEA students with a Hungarian registration certificate and registered address are eligible ('right of free movement and residence').

Only 'certain' EEA citizens qualify (the English page's wording), i.e. those whose free-movement status meets the regulation's legal basis, which may exclude students who are only in Hungary to study. Confirm with Diákhitel customer service (+36 1 999 99 44).

items.notes: Requires access to the Hungarian Ügyfélkapu e-government login, which a foreign student may not have.

items.name_it: Prestito studentesco Diákhitel2 (per le tasse universitarie)
items.description: Interest-free (0%, 100% state interest subsidy) loan that pays the fee of a self-financed (önköltséges) programme at a Hungarian higher-education institution, up to the full fee, paid directly to the institution.

other: studying in a self-financed programme in Hungary
same citizenship/status conditions as Diákhitel1 (Hungarian citizen, refugee, long-term resident, or person with free-movement right as defined by the regulation)

items.amount: Up to the full tuition of the self-financed programme; 0% interest
items.how_to_apply: Online with an electronic signature via the Government Portal (Ügyfélkapu).

interpretations.hypothesis: EU/EEA students with a registration certificate and registered address in Hungary can use it for self-financed tuition (e.g. Semmelweis English programmes).
Only 'certain' EEA citizens qualify; eligibility of EU students who are in Hungary only to study is not confirmed.

items.notes: No page confirmed whether English-language, EUR-priced programmes count as 'önköltséges' for Diákhitel2.

items.name_local: Kizárólag egészségügyi szolgáltatásra jogosultak – nappali tagozatos hallgatók
items.name_it: Diritto all'assistenza sanitaria per studenti a tempo pieno
items.description: Free entitlement to Hungarian public health care (not cash benefits) for adult full-time students who are Hungarian citizens, refugees or protected persons, and for foreign nationals studying under an international agreement or a scholarship granted by the education or foreign-affairs minister. Students must count as 'domestic' for social security.

other: full-time (nappali) student
Hungarian citizen / refugee / protected person, OR foreign national studying under an international agreement or ministerial scholarship (e.g. Stipendium Hungaricum)

items.how_to_apply: Through student status; TAJ card from the government office.

interpretations.hypothesis: Self-financed EU/EEA students are not covered: the page names Hungarian citizens, refugees and protected persons only, so they rely on their EHIC/home insurance.

EU/EEA students with registered residence over 3 months count as 'domestic', and equal treatment may extend the student entitlement to them; the page does not say so explicitly. Confirm with NEAK/government office.

items.description: Discounted monthly Budapest-wide pass for students: HUF 3,450 vs HUF 8,950 full price. BKK lists it as available to EU citizens with an EU student ID and proof of address in Hungary.

other: day or evening course (not correspondence)
valid student ID; foreign EU/EEA/Swiss student IDs need an official Hungarian address document or accommodation certificate (from 15 June 2026)
ISIC accepted only if it names a school based outside Hungary

items.how_to_apply: Buy at BKK sales points/app and carry the student ID (and address document) when travelling.

interpretations.hypothesis: Non-EU students are not entitled (BKK: discounts are for EEA and Swiss citizens).
Non-EU students holding a Hungarian student ID from a Hungarian university may be entitled; BKK's English pages do not address this case. Confirm with BKK.

items.notes: Swiss eligibility comes from the discounts page; the prices page mentions EU citizens only.

items.name_it: Agevolazione IRPEF per giovani sotto i 25 anni
items.description: Under-25s pay no personal income tax on employment (and some self-employment) income up to HUF 715,765 per month in 2026, saving up to HUF 107,365/month. The employer applies it automatically. Foreign individuals qualify if they are EEA citizens, or citizens of a non-EEA state bordering Hungary (e.g. Ukraine, Serbia), and meet the other conditions.

other: applies up to and including the month you turn 25
also open to citizens of non-EEA states bordering Hungary (e.g. Ukraine, Serbia), not to other non-EU citizens
income from employment or listed self-employment in Hungary

items.amount: Tax base allowance up to HUF 715,765/month (2026) = up to HUF 107,365/month PIT saved
items.how_to_apply: Automatic via the employer; unused allowance can be claimed in the annual tax return.
items.stackable: Can be combined with other PIT allowances in a fixed order (after the mothers-of-four allowance, before the personal and family allowances).
items.notes: The 2026 cap is from the NAV student-work page (dated 2026-10-14); the dedicated allowance page still shows the 2025 figure (HUF 656,785). Swiss eligibility not stated. Social-security contributions are still due.

items.authority: Semmelweis University, Directorate of International Relations / Mobility Office
items.description: Semmelweis's mobility pages currently say the Erasmus+ programme 'will be available again soon' and that applications will be announced. The page gives no reason and no specific notice for incoming students. No Hungarian or Semmelweis top-up for incoming Erasmus students was found.
items.how_to_apply: Contact the Semmelweis mobility office before planning an Erasmus+ exchange.
items.notes: Whether incoming Erasmus+ exchanges to Semmelweis are currently possible is not confirmed. A human should check the reason with the university.

items.name_it: Borsa di eccellenza Pannonia In della Semmelweis
items.description: Merit-based scholarship for foreign students already enrolled in English or German programmes, after at least 2 completed semesters. Per academic year: Medicine and Dentistry HUF 2,000,000; Pharmacy HUF 1,300,000; Health Sciences HUF 900,000; András Pető Faculty HUF 2,900,000; paid in 12 monthly instalments. Italy is in category 1 (preferred) of the 2024/25 country appendix.

other: citizen of a country in the call's appendix (2024/25 appendix: category 1 includes most EU/EEA states, Switzerland, UK, USA; category 2 others)
foreign national enrolled in an English/German programme at Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Health Sciences or András Pető Faculty
studies started in or after the first semester of 2024/25
at least 2 completed active semesters
not a Stipendium Hungaricum or Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship holder
HUF bank account set in Neptun

items.amount: HUF 900,000–2,900,000 per academic year depending on faculty (Medicine HUF 2,000,000)
items.how_to_apply: Via the Neptun Requests interface during the call window.
items.stackable: Not combinable with Stipendium Hungaricum or the Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship.
items.notes: The country appendix linked on the page is labelled 2024/25 while the call is 2025/26; the current list may differ. For reference, General Medicine (English) tuition is EUR 9,340/semester plus one-time fees for the September 2027 intake (semmelweis.hu/admission/programs/medicine/).
